findings.title: 46-operation executable semantic/API publication is incomplete
findings.observed: No operation has exact method/path; all12 queries have empty field lists. Exact operation result_ref entity/source, response/event schema field graphs, object columns/child payload writes and authoritative owner snapshot contracts are still explicitly required, not published by this proposal.
findings.repair: Publish a lineage-linked exact successor with every operation request/path/query/response, concrete column-level write/read sets, event payloads, independently resolvable typedSources and entity-specific tenant/purpose-authorized owner refetch ports. Register every added operation/event/schema/slice/PEP/dependency; do not retain100 as a target.
acceptance: All46 proposed operations or reviewed replacements have exact route/request/query/response/event/source closure against real FK/column oracle.
Every business UUID resolves to intended entity under tenant; snapshot schema/version/owner/refetch and digest are independently registered.
No pending/unknown/failed command exposes completed artifact; result_ref source/entity pinned per operation.

findings.title: Anonymous envelope/PEP/role/privacy retention boundary is still proposed only
findings.observed: New exact table proposals fix the former missing-table issue, but verified issuer envelope schema/validation, no-principal route interceptor, separate identity/protected/analysis database roles, response-safe logging/audit, key/retention owner contracts and actual duties/slices/commands are not allocated. HMAC algorithm/domain-tag declarations are not yet executable byte framing or key lifecycle.
findings.repair: Publish exact envelope and generated schema plus typed ingestion adapter; allocate no caller-bound audit/idempotency interception on submit; define role/schema ACLs and key-versioned canonical HMAC framing, legal-hold/replay expiry and governed retention duties. Keep identity issuer unable to read protected responses/receipts; analysis only cohort projections. Avoid absolute anonymity claim.
acceptance: Foreign tenant/survey/form, forged or expired envelope, wrong token/key version and concurrent duplicate fail safely without a second response.
Issuer/analysis/general runtime cannot query or join token/receipt/identity tables; principal/token/raw answers/precise counts absent from telemetry/public projection.
Same-token same-payload returns one receipt; different payload is opaque mismatch; key rotation/replay expiry/legal hold tests use concrete bytes and roles.
Repeated/differencing cohort queries and free-text identifiers undergo explicitly allocated privacy review.

findings.title: Erasure/replay protected receipt state is not closed
findings.observed: Receipt retention requires ERASED and tombstone preservation, but response.erase businessWrites names only responses/answer_values, not protected receipt. Anonymous submit receipt responseStates lists only ACCEPTED, while persisted protected receipt status permits ACCEPTED and ERASED. Same-token replay after erase/window closure lacks an exact cross-object outcome/order.
findings.repair: Specify atomic erase write set including protected receipt ERASED and intact token tombstone; define replay-before-new-admission ordering and exact public ERASED versus opaque expired projection. Erasure must not reopen token or create second response; avoid returning stale ACCEPTED as if live content remained.
acceptance: Submit -> erase -> same token/same payload: zero new responses, no erased answer refetch, correct ERASED or opaque expiry output.
Erase concurrent with replay/retention purge and same-token different payload yields one linearized safe outcome.
Parent survey lifecycle unaffected by individual erasure.

findings.title: Fixture checker is deliberately bounded and does not validate typed request/replay outcomes
findings.observed: 10 self-tests pass arithmetic/aliases and selected isolation expectations. Validator loads fixture JSON only, not proposal schemas. In-memory changing same-token expected output to sameProtectedReceipt=false/newResponseCount=1 returns no errors; adding UNKNOWN sourceMode to WFM fixture also returns no errors. Therefore PASS cannot evidence mode/HMAC/concurrent replay or exact schema validity.
findings.repair: Bridge each fixture to exact operation request/owner artifact schema and column/event/receipt expectations; add independent fixture mutations for every discriminated branch and replay/erase/expiry/denied/correction outcome. Keep arithmetic checks and NOT_EXECUTED_G4 wording; collect actual implementations in G4.
acceptance: Healthy concrete requests for native/snapshot and bounded-text/template each validate; missing/mixed/unknown mode and malformed nested payload reject.
Same-token replay/erase/expiry expected-result corruption is detected by fixture validator.
ConfigA/B inputs determine expected row/state/event/result rather than hard-coded success labels; actual G4 evidence records exact tests/commands.
